DeployBot: starting deploy to dedicated-prod-eu1 · tag=redwood/v2.4.1-rc3 · canary=10% (3 pods) · change_window=2026-03-19T22:00Z UTC
andrew: ack, I tagged infra knobs for the rollout (batching=auto, kv_cache=on)
jia: quick heads up — traffic shaping is on for canary, will run for 10m then promote if healthy
DeployBot: canary started · pods: realtime-1, realtime-2, realtime-3 · commit=6b3f2d9
ops-bot: metric alert rule loaded: "canary-5m-5xx" threshold=0.8% (notify slack if breached)
maria: tracking perf tests, running a 5m qps ramp to 200rps against canary
DeployBot: healthchecks: 200/200 OK · avg p50=48ms · p95=220ms · 5xx=0.12%
sasha: seeing a small p95 bump on image-encoder, looks like cold starts on first requests
jia: okay, let's hold promotion if 5xx > 1% or error spikes in next 10m. Also pin model-weights config to v1.9 for this rollout
andrew: pinned config `model.weights=redwood-model-v1.9` across canary pods
DeployBot: canary 10% -> stable 30% (scale up) · starting gradual promotion
ops-bot: alert: latency-up by 8% on decoder-service (p95) during scale-up at 1769876600
maria: noted, running a tracer on decoder-service, pulling spans now
DeployBot: promotion paused at 30% due to latency anomaly · collecting logs and heap dumps
andrew: if heap looks noisy we can revert runtime flag `use_new_alloc` — I'll prepare a rollback playbook
jia: prefer to wait 5m and let caches warm, only rollback if 5xx > 1% or sustained p95 > 350ms for 5m
sasha: heap looks fine, codec threads are spiking for a specific shard, maybe due to longer sequences in some requests
DeployBot: canary metrics updated: p95=310ms · 5xx=0.18% · sustained for 3m
andrew: preparing `kubectl rollout undo deploy/realtime -n dedicated-prod-eu1 --to-revision=redwood/v2.4.0` in case we need to roll back quickly
jia: approve the rollback playbook, but hold until 5m threshold crossed. Also add a tagging note in the release: "pin-to-v2.4.0-if-rollback"
ops-bot: scheduled incident channel standup in #incidents if rollback triggers · auto-bridge on rollback
DeployBot: resuming promotion to 60% after 4m · metrics re-evaluated and within tolerances; will continue with 15m steady window
maria: continuous load shows p95 trending down to 240ms after second warm-up round
sasha: observed a hotspot in `decoder pool` on pod realtime-7, added a short-lived thread dump to ticket INF-421
DeployBot: promotion complete to 100% · final status: healthy · final tag applied=redwood/v2.4.1-rc3
andrew: good run. created INF-421 to track decoder hotspot and follow-up action (owner=sasha)
jia: decided: no rollback. We'll pin the release for 48h observation and revert config if regression surfaces. Add changelog note for the model config pin and decoder threading tweak
maria: I'll run an eval sweep on recent prompts against v2.4.1-rc3 overnight and post results in #eng-ml
DeployBot: deploy finished 1769876799 · summary: duration=256s · rollback=false · notes=minor latency blip during scale-up, ticket INF-421 opened
andrew: closing the deploy channel thread. If anything spikes, ping here and we'll execute the rollback playbook
sasha: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
